sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Heavy; confused. Pain as if temples were
crushed together. Worse, shaking or noise. Crushing
headache. Pressure on top. Hair gray early in life;
falls out. Dull headache after coition ; from eye-strain.
[ATot. m.] Vertigo toward evening, when standing or
walking.

sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
Blue rings around. Lids inflamed and cold.
Pupils dilated. Glassy appearance. Feel too large.
Amblyopia in masturbators. Optic nerves seem torpid.
Pain as if eyeballs were forcibly pressed together and
into head.

sections.text:
Roaring, with difficult hearing.

sections.label: Mouth
sections.text:
Lips dry, cracked. Bleeding gums; retract
from teeth. Tongue swollen, dry, with viscid, frothy
mucus. Teeth feel cold. At night, bites tongue in-
voluntarily.

sections.label: Face
sections.text:
Pale, earthy ; feeling of tension as from dried
albumen. Sensation of coldness of one side of face.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Craves juicy things. Sour risings. Nau-
sea. Symptoms following sour food and drink. Pres-
sure as from a weight, with sleepiness after eating.
[Pel tauri.] Thirst for cold milk.

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Distention and fermentation in bowels.
Enlarged spleen. [Ceanoth.] Aching in umbilical re-
gion. Loud rumbling.

sections.label: Stool
sections.text:
Diarrhoea, white, watery, involuntary, pain-
less, with much flatus; not specially exhausting.

sections.label: Urine
sections.text:
Frequent, profuse, watery, milky. Diabetes.
Micturition, preceded by anxiety and followed by burn-
ing. Frequent urination at night.

sections.label: Male
sections.text:
Emissions at night and at stool. Seminal
> vesiculitis. I0.ral. acid.] Sexual power deficient; testi-

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Menses too early and profuse, with pain in
liver. Itching; yellow leucorrhcea after menses. Milk
scanty; health deteriorated from nursing.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Chest troubles develop after brain-fag.
Hoarseness. Dry cough from tickling in chest. Salty
expectoration. Difficult respiration. Weak feeling in
chest from talking. [.S'/nnn.] Pressure behind the ster-
num, rendering breathing difficult.

sections.label: Heart
sections.text:
Palpitation in children who grow too fast;
after grief, self-abuse. Pulse irregular, intermittent.

sections.label: Back
sections.text:
Boring pain between scapulae. Pain in back
and limbs, as if beaten.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Weak. Tearing pains in joints, kmes,
and periosteum. Cramps in upper arms and wrists.
Great debility. Pains at night, as if bones were scraped.
Stumbles easily and makes missteps. Itching, between
fingers or in folds of joints.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Pimples, acne, blood-boils. Ulcers, with very
offensive pus. Burning red rash. Formication in vari-
ous parts. Falling out of the hair, [Nat, mur.; Seleri.]
Tendency to abscess after fevers.

sections.label: Sleep
sections.text:
Somnolency.' Lascivious dreams with emis-
sions.

sections.label: Fever
sections.text:
Chilliness. Profuse sweat during night and
morning. Low types of fever, with dull comprehension
and stupor.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
Better, from keeping warm. Worse, ex-
ertion, from being talked to; loss of vital fluids; sexual
excesses.
